# Research references

open-headunit/ is a local, ignored checkout of:
https://github.com/andreknieriem/open-headunit

Inspected commit: a4f80ff1b6aa6726c17e7385192cf23abe0d0e9f.
Upstream license: AGPL-3.0; the checkout retains its LICENSE and original copyright notices.

The checkout is not a Gradle dependency and is not included in the APK.
The projection module does not require the checkout to build.
Do not replace this with a moving build-time download or silently compile the complete upstream application.
Any later source reuse must preserve the appropriate upstream license and attribution.
